name: Yourin'yuiki
source:
One of the ancient nature spirits who serves the pantheon of Elven gods. He has mastery over the sphere of fire and lesser spirits of that element.

[Spoiler] The inhabitants of the Lauroso domain living under the shadow of the dormant volcano he inhabited made a pact with him ages ago which kept both him and the volcano dormant. Fia's arrival in pursuit of the missing Avaro awakened him and rendered the pact null and void. Once awakened, he would not rest until his primal instinct for destruction was sated and the dominion under the volcano reduced to smouldering ash.

He initially mistakes Fia as an imposter of his master and must be subdued before he swears allegiance to Fia once more. Oddly enough Fia does not sense any familiarity with him unlike the other three guardians when they first meet. His subjugation is a major reason behind Lishenzeri's pledging of loyalty to Fia as her master. [/Spoiler]
